description: Dispatch an async job that probes six configured API-user READ capabilities (lead field schema, lead query, activity type catalog, current-day API usage, campaign listing, static list listing) and reports the specific Access API Role permission missing for any that fail; returns {job_id, status} in milliseconds — poll check_marketo_job_status(job_id) for the finished report. This is broader than test_connection, which only checks credentials. Write/execute verbs cannot be safely probed and remain explicit in writes_unverified. ⚠ Two coverage limits, not one: beyond unprobed writes, all six probes are Lead-API reads, so reads_verified says nothing about the Role's SEPARATE Read-Only Assets and Read-Write Assets Access API permissions gating /rest/asset/v1/ — an instance can report reads_verified=true and still hold neither. That gap is an operator screen (Admin → Users & Roles), not an API question; treat it as a requirement to verify, never as an assurance from this verb.
embedding_description: Audit the configured Marketo API user's Access API Role across lead schema, lead query, activity metadata, API usage, campaign listing, and static list listing, with per-capability permission diagnostics and remediation guidance.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with job_id (pass to check_marketo_job_status) and status 'queued'. The completed job result is a dict with reads_verified (bool, READ capabilities only — NOT the whole setup), checks (a list of {capability, verb, status, error_code?, error_message?, guidance?} per probe), writes_unverified (verb names whose permissions can't be probed safely), writes_unverified_note.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: A queued job has probed nothing yet: give the job_id and poll check_marketo_job_status. Once completed: if reads_verified is false, lead with the specific failed capability + its guidance (exact Role permission to add, or the correct admin screen for a partition/credential problem) rather than a generic 'setup incomplete'. Always mention writes_unverified so the operator knows write/trigger permission gaps can still surface later even when reads_verified=true. When reads_verified=true, scope the claim to the six Lead-API READ capabilities actually probed — it is not a whole-setup pass, and in particular it carries no information about the separate Read-Only Assets and Read-Write Assets permissions, which only an operator can confirm in Admin → Users & Roles.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Never report reads_verified or any probe outcome from THIS verb's response -- it carries only the job handle. The report appears once check_marketo_job_status reports status=completed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job that checks which capabilities the configured Marketo API user's Role actually grants.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Refused at dispatch with no job created: marketo.invalid_params when session_id/flow_id are missing from the calling context. Reported later in check_marketo_job_status's error field: marketo.not_configured: no marketo_instance address-book entry registered yet — nothing to check. marketo.auth_failed: the OAuth credentials were rejected before any probe ran. A probe the Role refuses is NOT a job error: it appears as a failed entry in checks.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.not_configured: register the marketo_instance address-book entry first (see hydration_guidance.md), then run check_setup. marketo.auth_failed: run test_connection and ask the operator to check the LaunchPoint custom service's client_id/client_secret.
